children: Lingyi Zhizao jumped more than 8% after a China Securities Journal report said industry-chain sources identified the company as a supplier for Apple's first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, according to Jiemian News. The report did not provide further details on the scope of the supply relationship.

title: Lingyi Zhizao Surges Over 8% on Reported Apple Foldable iPhone Duo Supply Link
